coherence_masking.valid_pixel_mask_definition: Static mask where coherence summary is greater than or equal to COH_THRESHOLD.
coherence_masking.valid_time_mask_definition: Dynamic mask where date-attributed pairwise coherence is greater than or equal to COH_THRESHOLD.

sbas_displacement_raw.description: Raw SBAS cumulative LOS displacement from PyGMTSAR LSQ inversion.

sbas_displacement_masked.description: Raw SBAS cumulative LOS displacement masked by dynamic coherence.

sbas_velocity_raw.description: Raw SBAS LOS velocity. For short stacks, interpret cautiously.

sbas_rmse_raw.description: Raw SBAS RMSE converted to LOS millimetres.

pairwise_coherence_attributed_to_date.description: Approximate per-acquisition quality layer. Computed by averaging pairwise interferogram coherence values for all pairs that include each acquisition date. This is not a direct single-date coherence measurement.

coherence_pair_count_per_date.description: Number of pairwise interferogram coherence layers contributing to pairwise_coherence_attributed_to_date for each acquisition date.

scientific_notes: pairwise_coherence_attributed_to_date is a quality-control product derived from pairwise coherence. It should not be described as true single-date coherence.
Segmentation output is intentionally disabled in this workflow. Use sbas_displacement_raw or sbas_displacement_masked for interpretation.
Annualized velocity from short time windows can be unstable and may reflect atmosphere, event discontinuities, or unwrapping artifacts.
